traits.desc: Build an invention on the right side of the board. After 8 seconds, the invention activates, triggering each of its Modules.

traits.name: Quickstriker
traits.desc: Your team gains 15% Attack Speed. Quickstrikers gain bonus Attack Speed based on their target's missing Health.

traits.name: Riftscourge
traits.desc:
Baron Nashor takes up 2 team slots and grants +2 to the Void trait.

After 8 seconds, the board enters a Void Rift. The Rift grants Void units 30% Damage Amp and constantly strikes enemies with bolts of plasma, dealing 5% max Health as magic damage.

traits.name: Rune Mage
traits.desc:
The Rune Mage benefits from all active Region traits, but contributes to none.

He harnesses the Runic power from active Region traits to modify his Ability, enhancing it in unique ways.

traits.name: Shadow Isles
traits.desc:
Whenever ANY champion dies in a player combat, gain Souls (%i:scaleSouls%). Shadow Isles champions' Abilities are uniquely empowered based on the number of Souls you have.

Shadow Isles champions gain Attack Damage and Ability Power.

Souls Collected: ? %i:scaleSouls%

traits.name: Shurima
traits.desc:
Each second, Shurimans gain 2% Attack Speed and restore 20 Health. At combat start, they gain additional effects.

Prismatic: Unlock Nasus, Renekton, and Xerath, then field 4 Shurima

stats.4: A Shuriman ascends to GODHOOD every 3 seconds Only available when Nasus, Renekton, and Xerath have been unlocked.

traits.name: Slayer
traits.desc: Slayers gain Omnivamp and Attack Damage. They increase the bonus Attack Damage by up to 50% based on their missing Health.

traits.name: Soulbound
traits.desc:
Lucian and Senna fight together, swapping when either casts. Each champion has a unique ability.

Your strongest Soulbound pair grants bonuses to your team while they survive. While Senna is out, all allies gain 7% Damage Reduction. While Lucian is out, all allies gain 7% Damage Amp.

traits.name: Star Forger
traits.desc:
Aurelion Sol gains 25/30/100% increased Stardust for each other unique Targonian fielded in combat.

Current Bonus: ?%

traits.name: Targon
traits.desc: Targonians are forged by the stars. They are traitless, but stronger than the average champion.

traits.name: The Boss
traits.desc:
When Sett first drops below 45% max Health, he leaves combat to start doing sit-ups. Each sit-up restores 15% max Health and gives him 60% Attack and Move Speed.

If he reaches full Health, he returns to combat Pumped Up, converting all damage from his attacks and Ability to true damage. If all of his allies die, he immediately returns to combat.

traits.name: Vanquisher
traits.desc: Vanquishers' abilities can critically strike. They also gain Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage.

traits.name: Void
traits.desc:
Gain Mutations that only Void champions can use. Void champions gain Attack Speed.

Champions can only have one Mutation at a time. Benching a champion removes their Mutation.

stats.9: Mutations become supercharged, increasing their power by 100%. 40% %i:scaleAS%

traits.name: Warden
traits.desc: When Wardens first drop below 75% and 25% Health, they gain a Shield based on their max Health.

traits.name: World Ender
traits.desc:
Aatrox gains Attack Damage equal to 200% of his Omnivamp.

On first death, he becomes briefly untargetable and heals back to full Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, he reduces his maximum Mana by 10 and gains 20% Durability.

stats.2: Yordles gain 40 Health and 5% Attack Speed for each unique Yordle fielded. 3 star Yordles grant 120% more!
stats.4: AND your first shop each round has a Yordle in it!
stats.6: AND get 1 free rerolls each round!
stats.8: AND get a Yordle Grab Bag each round!

traits.name: Zaun
traits.desc:
After 4 seconds, Zaunites become Shimmer-Fused, granting them 15% Durability and 90% decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

After a short cooldown, they become Shimmer-Fused again.

stats.5: At 60% Health, Zaunites restore 30% Health over 3 seconds and instantly become Shimmer-Fused.
stats.7: Shimmer-Fused bonuses are increased by 50%. Refresh after 3 seconds instead.

traits.name: Shepherd
traits.desc:
Shepherds summon the Bond of the Stars to aid them in battle.

Bia and Bayin's power are increased by the total star level of all Shepherds.

stats.7: Bia and Bayin's bond grows deeper

traits.name: Shimmerscale
traits.desc: Gain Shimmerscale items. These items give gold as well as combat power.

stats.1: Gain Goldmancers Staff. At Stage 3-1 gain Draven's Axe.

traits.name: Sniper
traits.desc: Snipers gain Damage Amp, increased against targets farther away.

traits.name: Space Groove
traits.desc: The Groove: ?% %i:scaleAS%, ?% %i:scaleHPRegen%

stats.1: Groovians can enter The Groove. While in it, they gain Attack Speed and max Health Regen, increased per Groovian on your team.
stats.3: All Groovians start combat in The Groove for 4 seconds.
stats.5: Each second spent in The Groove grants 5% stacking Attack Damage and Ability Power.

traits.name: Stargazer
traits.desc:
Stargazers chart a different constellation every game.

Stargazers in empowered hexes gain various bonuses, starting at (3) units.

More hexes reveal at each player level.

traits.name: Stargazer (The Altar)
traits.desc:
Stargazers chart a different constellation every game. This game: The Altar.

More hexes reveal at each player level

stats.3:
When ANY champion dies, they are sacrificed to the Altar. Allies in empowered hexes gain 8% Health and 8% Attack Speed.

After 60 sacrifices, Stargazers in empowered hexes gain an additional 20% %i:scaleHealth% and 18% %i:scaleAS%

Sacrifices: (? / 60)

traits.name: Stargazer (The Boar)
traits.desc:
Stargazers chart a different constellation every game. This game: The Boar.

Gain gold after winning player combat. Allies in empowered hexes gain 8% Health, Attack Damage, and Ability Power. Stargazers gain more.

(Gold Earned: ?)

More hexes reveal at each player level

traits.name: Stargazer (The Fountain)
traits.desc:
Stargazers chart a different constellation every game. This game: The Fountain.

Allies in empowered hexes heal 1% max Health every 2 seconds. Stargazers in empowered hexes heal an additional 3% and gain stacking Attack Damage and Ability Power every 2 seconds.

More hexes reveal at each player level

traits.name: Stargazer (The Huntress)
traits.desc:
Stargazers chart a different constellation every game. This game: The Huntress.

Combat Start: Mark the highest Health enemies.

Allies in empowered hexes gain 15% Attack Speed. Stargazers in empowered hexes gain more and heal for 15% of their max Health when a marked enemy dies.

More hexes reveal at each player level

traits.name: Stargazer (The Medallion)
traits.desc:
Stargazers chart a different constellation every game. This game: The Medallion.

(Current Bonus: ?% %i:scaleDA%)

More hexes reveal at each player level

stats.3: Allies in empowered hexes gain 15% Damage Amp, which increases by 5% for each 3-star ally.

traits.name: Stargazer (The Mountain)
traits.desc:
Stargazers chart a different constellation every game. This game: The Mountain

Every 5 player combats, gain a Stargazer Emblem. Stargazers in empowered hexes gain various bonuses.

(Combats Remaining: 5)

More hexes reveal at each player level

stats.4: AND 15% Attack Damage and Ability Power
stats.8: AND increase all other bonuses by 10%

traits.name: Stargazer (The Serpent)
traits.desc:
Stargazers chart a different constellation every game. This game: The Serpent.

Allies in empowered hexes gain 5% Durability. Stargazers in empowered hexes gain more and poison enemies, repeating a portion of damage dealt as magic damage over 3 seconds.

More hexes reveal at each player level

traits.name: Storyweaver
traits.desc: Summon a Hero named Kayle and evolve her as you level up!

stats.1: When you reach level 5, Kayle upgrades to 2-star. Pick a supportive effect.
stats.2:
Kayle evolves again at levels 6, 8 and 10:
Level 6: Pick a combat effect.
Level 8: Kayle upgrades to 3-star. Pick a combat effect.
Level 10: Kayle upgrades to 4-star.

traits.name: The Crew
traits.desc:
Summon the Nocturnus to aid you in battle! It fires a rocket that deals 105 magic damage every 420 damage your team deals.

2-cost and higher champions become Crew members after reaching 3-star. Gain additional bonuses for each Crew member.

(1x ☆☆☆): + 2 free rerolls when you star up a unit you fielded last combat.
(2x ☆☆☆): Rockets deal 130 damage.
(3x ☆☆☆): + 1 free reroll / round.
(4x ☆☆☆): Rockets fire every 200 damage dealt. Gain 4 XP per round.

traits.name: Timebreaker
traits.desc:
Rerolls on Loss: 1
XP on Win: 1

stats.3: AND When you lose, gain free rerolls. When you win, store XP in a Temporal Core (scales with stage).
stats.4: AND Timebreakers gain an additional 50% Attack Speed

traits.name: Vanguard
traits.desc:
Vanguards gain 5% Durability while Shielded.

Combat start and 50% Health: Gain a max Health Shield for 10 seconds.

traits.name: Voyager
traits.desc:
Combat Start: Your Tanks gain a Shield for 15 seconds. Your other allies gain Damage Amp.

Voyagers gain double.

traits.name: Yordle
traits.desc: After each player combat, gain a Yordle Grab Bag full of Yordle-y loot!

stats.2: If you fielded 5 or more 3-star champions, your Yordle Grab Bag will contain a Yordle-Lord.

traits.name: Yordle-Lord
traits.desc: Yordle-Lord Veigar and his Furyhorns are crashing Pengu's Party!
